page.overview:
Who is Zandar?

Zandar is a world-class master of camouflage and covert movement, which means he’s an expert at hiding and sneaking up on people. He is so talented at it that he often does it in plain sight. Despite his garish outfit, he somehow manages to make himself unnoticeable until it is too late for his intended target. It is a skill he has worked to near perfection. We don't know why he chose this particular ability. Maybe his siblings' more dominant personalities pushed him at the back so he decided to be the best at hiding?

On his first filecard and cartoon, he only was presented as a stealth and camouflage expert while in the comics and second filecard, he is also an accomplished character actor, playing the roles of “everyman”, which can easily be overlooked by adversaries. He uses these skills in infiltration and assassination.

In the IDW version, Zandar and his sister Zarana are twins (and not related to Zartan) while other versions never mentioned this, only presented them as siblings and siblings of Zartan) and are largely inseparable, with Zandar so psychologically and emotionally attached to his sister that they continue wearing matching clothing elements even as adults, even having hair dyed the same color and styled the same way at times. Still in the IDW version, the twins are the same height (5’8”) and have auburn hair. They also are so close that they share a secret twin language.

In the Sunbow cartoon, Zandar and Zarana's relation is more like an aggressive one, both insulting and fighting each other like some siblings do. Despite being voiced by Peter Cullen, Zandar has very few presence or lines in all of the series.
